places-aztec-ruins-national-monument-cha.story: 233 km from Aztec to Aztec, about 4 h 01 of riding. It goes by way of Twin Angels, Halfway House, Chaco Culture and back through Halfway House. The highest point is about 2,050 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
